name: City Run VR Ultimate
summary:
City Run VR Ultimate is the next-generation indoor cardio running experience designed for Meta Quest 2, 3, and 3S.

Tired of boring treadmills? Put on your headset, jog or run in place, and immerse yourself in a vibrant living city with realistic pedestrian life, traffic, and dynamic weather.

🏃 KEY FEATURES:
• Natural VR Locomotion: Responsive motion tracking translates your natural jogging and arm swing into smooth in-game movement.
